page_title: REN 1-2 TOU | Rennes v Toulouse 13/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Poor challenge! Ludovic Blas (Rennes) is penalised for tripping and Florent Batta blows his whistle.
90+1' What was Ibrahim Salah (Rennes) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Desire Doue (Rennes) takes the corner but it's cleared.
90' Arthur Theate (Rennes) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
88' The referee is firm and issues Bertug Yildirim (Rennes) a deserved yellow card.
88' Guillaume Restes (Toulouse) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
86' Rennes are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
84' Carles Martinez has decided to make a change. Frank Magri (Toulouse) replaces Thijs Dallinga.
83' The manager makes a subsitution with Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse) coming on for Yann Gboho.
81' Stijn Spierings (Toulouse) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
79' Guillaume Restes (Toulouse) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
79' Desire Doue (Rennes) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
78' The resulting corner, taken by Desire Doue (Rennes), comes to nothing. Rennes get a corner.

78' Desire Doue (Rennes) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the top right corner, but Guillaume Restes thwarts him with a great two-handed save. The referee signals a corner kick to Rennes.
75' Florent Batta blows his whistle for a foul after Guela Doue (Rennes) hacks down one of his opponents.
72' Surely that's handball by one of the Toulouse players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
71' Jeanuel Belocian goes off the pitch and Christopher Wooh (Rennes) comes on.
71' Julien Stephan has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ibrahim Salah (Rennes) replacing Baptiste Santamaria.
71' That will be all from Amine Gouiri who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Bertug Yildirim (Rennes).
71' He should have scored! Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
70' Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse) misses a complete sitter from the corner, heading the ball well wide of the left post from close in.
70' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
68' 54:46 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
65' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
63' The corner is swung in and Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse) leaps above the defence only to send his header a whisker over the bar from close in.
62' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) will deliver the corner kick.
61' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
60' Julien Stephan has decided to substitute Benjamin Bourigeaud and he is replaced by Ludovic Blas (Rennes).
60' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
54' Here is a change. Christian Mawissa Elebi is going off and Carles Martinez gives the last tactical orders to Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse).
54' Substitution. Zakaria Aboukhlal leaves the pitch and is replaced by Aron Donnum (Toulouse).
53' Desire Doue (Rennes) sprays a pass out to Arnaud Kalimuendo, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
51' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Toulouse was in an offside position.

49' Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the right post is, however, superbly saved by Guillaume Restes!
48' Desire Doue (Rennes) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
46' Florent Batta blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Rennes take a short corner kick.
43' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
41' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) bends the ball in from the edge of the box which worries the keeper, but it eventually sails just wide of the left post.
39' The shots on goal statistics – 2:3.
38' Problems for Julien Stephan as Enzo Le Fee is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Fabian Rieder (Rennes) replaces him.
36' The game is interrupted now, Enzo Le Fee (Rennes) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
34' Christian Mawissa Elebi (Toulouse) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
32' 1 - 2 Goal! Moussa Diarra (Toulouse) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:2.
30' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it just wide of the right post.
28' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
25' Toulouse seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
22' 1 - 1 Goal! Stijn Spierings tees up Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the left side of the goal. 1:1.
20' 1 - 0 Desire Doue (Rennes) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Guillaume Restes with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:0.

17' Desire Doue (Rennes) is untouchable as he tricks his way into the box. His shot, though, lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies a whisker wide of the right post. That would have been a great goal!
16' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

14' Guela Doue (Rennes) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant low pass, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem. That should have been a goalscoring opportunity.
11' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) is penalised for a foul. Florent Batta had a clear view and blows his whistle.
8' A cross from the corner kick arrives at the feet of Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse), giving him an opportunity to shoot. He misses completely, way over the bar.
8' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) steps up to send the ball in.
4' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) takes a short corner kick.
3' Guillaume Restes (Toulouse) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball is out of play. Rennes will have a throw-in.
1' The first half has started.
Rennes will kick-off.
Florent Batta got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
